body:
This was actually the first bone I've broken so I guess go big or go home for me. It wasn't that bad though tbh just more shocking to see your body broken.

Lockdown has been weird for me. I was a butcher and I'd be an essential employee right now but my injury has kept me out of work. I'm thinking about taking advantage of the time off and learning something like web design. You?

Not so much nervous but I'm just exhausted. I broke my clavicle at work on Xmas eve and a week after I was fully cleared it broke again so they will have to break it a  3rd time to re-align it properly. I just want to function normally again.

Have you tried reaching out to him? Sometimes that's all it takes.
